en.title: How Powdered Drinks Are Made: From Ingredients to Sachet
en.description: A look at the production steps of an instant drink powder, and where quality is controlled along the way.

sections.heading: 1. Receiving and weighing
paragraphs: Ingredients are checked on arrival, stored by type, and weighed against the formula. Accurate weighing is the first control on taste.

sections.heading: 2. Blending
paragraphs: Dry ingredients go into a blender in a set order and for a set time. Too little mixing leaves uneven flavor, and too much can damage fine particles.

sections.heading: 3. Sieving and checks
paragraphs: The blend is sieved to remove lumps and foreign matter, then checked for moisture, color and taste against the approved sample.

sections.heading: 4. Filling and sealing
paragraphs: The powder is filled into sachets, pouches or jars to a set net weight. Seal quality matters because moisture is the main enemy of a powder.

sections.heading: 5. Packing and release
paragraphs: Finished packs are cartoned, labeled with a lot code, and released only after the batch passes the final checks.

id.title: Bagaimana Minuman Serbuk Dibuat: dari Bahan Baku sampai Sachet
id.description: Gambaran tahapan produksi minuman instan serbuk dan titik-titik pengendalian mutunya.

sections.heading: 1. Penerimaan dan penimbangan
paragraphs: Bahan baku diperiksa saat tiba, disimpan menurut jenisnya, dan ditimbang sesuai formula. Penimbangan yang akurat adalah kontrol pertama atas rasa.

sections.heading: 2. Pencampuran
paragraphs: Bahan kering dimasukkan ke mixer dalam urutan dan waktu tertentu. Pencampuran yang kurang membuat rasa tidak merata, dan yang berlebihan bisa merusak partikel halus.

sections.heading: 3. Pengayakan dan pemeriksaan
paragraphs: Campuran diayak untuk membuang gumpalan dan benda asing, lalu diperiksa kadar air, warna, dan rasanya terhadap sampel yang disetujui.

sections.heading: 4. Pengisian dan penyegelan
paragraphs: Serbuk diisi ke sachet, pouch, atau jar dengan berat neto yang ditetapkan. Kualitas segel sangat penting karena kelembapan adalah musuh utama serbuk.

sections.heading: 5. Pengepakan dan pelepasan
paragraphs: Produk jadi dimasukkan ke karton, diberi kode lot, dan hanya dilepas setelah batch lolos pemeriksaan akhir.
